common.continuousNumericalBoundaryCertificate: Every inserted/rounded node is traced to its original source segment with distance <=1e-12. Source segment order/endpoints are retained; convex distance to that segment bounds every intervening subsegment. No actual wider gap is closed by this numerical equivalence.

policy.actualResidual: Explicit existing P0-minus-P1 face only. Record complete geometry, area and source contacts. Ambiguous contacts require a real shared P1 chain terminal, with oriented left/right source identities (pinned original preferred), continued by at most the existing bound. A terminal exactly on a residual vertex may supply its source side. Never extend internal nodes, allocate by distance/ID, or invent a filler identity. Fail competing side assignments.
policy.fallback: Fail the new candidate and retain existing deployment. Never replace source administrative identities with one whole-country territory.
policy.geometry: All countries and selected feature rings enter one common node/segment arrangement before final P0/P1 locks. Preserve source identities and all positive components/holes. Extract labeled face boundaries without subsequent polygon simplification/independent overlay.

numericalModel.meaning: Common hot-pixel noding within the EXISTING 1e-12 representation policy; never equate an actual wider gap with a numerical difference.

policy.originalAssets: Raw upstream, original game seed, metadata and prior evidence byte-preserved in history.
priority: oriented pinned shared P1 chain-terminal continuation within its recorded residual face
unique pinned original P1 face membership for residual/overlap
unique positive-length selected P1 contact for an actual P0 residual

scope: Diagnostic administrative recovery only; no operational cells, migration, runtime cutover or global topology approval

topologyEvidence.noding: JSTS 2.12.1 MCIndexNoder + RobustLineIntersector; exact source doubles, no snap/round/buffer
topologyEvidence.periodicClosureExplanation: Paired +/-180 planar ring closures with the same source territory on both physical sides are internal map cuts, not coast, adjacency or self edges. Every interval is certified against locked P0; authoritative coordinates are unchanged.
